notes.title: The 'historical adventure' game that lets you ground pound an ogre is free on GOG
notes.content: "The First Templar trailer ground-pounds an ogre" is a headline we wrote back in 2011 and you better believe that the moment I stumbled upon it, I immediately wanted to know more. The good news for me (and for you, if you have even the slightest sense of functioning curiosity) is that The First Templar is also now free on GOG... Read more.

notes.title: The First Templar is 60% off this week!
notes.content:
[b]The First Templar[/b] follows the story of two main characters – a French Templar, and his companion, a noble lady who has been proclaimed a heretic. Taking control over these two unlikely allies, the player must uncover the [b]mysteries behind the Templar Order[/b], [b]play a role in a grand conspiracy[/b], and discover [b]the secret of the Holy Grail[/b]. The heroes face powerful opponents at every turn, including Sacracen, King Philip the IV of France and the Inquisition.

The First Templar features both [b]single player and co-op modes[/b]. When playing solo, the player can switch between the two characters, leaving the control of the second hero to the game’s AI. At any moment a second player can join in and take control of the AI-controlled hero.

notes.title: New Release - The First Templar
notes.content:
The First Templar is now available on Steam!

Uncover the mysteries behind the Templar Order, play a role in a grand conspiracy, and discover the secret of the Holy Grail as you face powerful opponents at every turn!

The Steam Special Edition contains bonus mission “The Arena”: Caught by the vile Byzantine, you have to survive the perils of the Arena. Fight for your life, face the Gauntlet and stage your escape. Choose who will stand beside you as you confront the Byzantine and his minions

The First Templar features both single player and co-op modes.
